newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Steel offers no 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Steel offers no 1996 dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Steel Tube Co Ltd have approved the firm's plan to offer no return to investors for the 1996 fiscal year, a company statement published in Tuesday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The company said the 1996 net profit would be used to make up for 1995 losses, so the company would not provide any cash dividend or bonus issue.
The company reaped 983,000 yuan net profit in 1996 based on international accounting standards, compared with a net loss of 42.962 millin yuan in 1995, the company's annual report said.
